gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Tests for {@link JulianChronology#isLeapYear(long)}. In the Julian calendar, a proleptic year is a leap year if and only if it is exactly divisible by 4.
ADDED i2: -11999988 is evenly divisible by 4 (-11999988 / 4 = -2999997), so {@code isLeapYear} must return {@code true} for this proleptic year.
ADDED i3: A proleptic year that is a multiple of 4 must be recognised as a leap year.
